value_flows.description: Token creation - owner set to info.sender, zero initial value for all rental/sell states
Value capture - info.funds held in token.bids for later transfer on finalize, refund on cancellation
Value capture - info.funds held in token.rentals for later transfer on finalize, refund on cancellation
Value transfer - sends funds from token.bids to prev_owner with fee deduction via BankMsg::Send
Value distribution - sends deposit_amount to landlord or traveler with fee deduction via BankMsg::Send
Value refund - sends deposit_amount back to traveler via BankMsg::Send
Value refund - sends deposit_amount back to traveler via BankMsg::Send
Partial value refund - sends refundable_amount (based on cancellation policy) back to traveler via BankMsg::Send
Value extraction - owner withdraws accumulated fees to external address via BankMsg::Send
Fee parameter change - modifies fee_percentage used in all value calculations
Balance increase via increase_balance - adds amount to denom balance
Balance decrease via decrease_balance - subtracts amount from denom balance
Fee value creation/update via SetFeeValue - stored as u64
Withdraw - transfers native tokens from contract balance to target address via BankMsg::Send
WithdrawToLandlord - transfers native tokens from contract balance to landlord address via BankMsg::Send
RefundToTenant - transfers native tokens from contract balance to tenant address via BankMsg::Send
DepositForLongTermRental - deposits native tokens into contract balance for rental
SetListForSell - sets sell price and denom for token
SetReservationForShortTerm - creates reservation with deposit handling
SetReservationForLongTerm - creates reservation with deposit handling

value_flows.flow_description: No value creation/movement in query functions - these are read-only. However, they expose token ownership, approvals, rental status, bids, and sell information which represent ownership rights and economic positions.

value_flows.description: Creation of rental/sale listings (LongTermRental, ShortTermRental, Sell). Value parameters (price, deposit, etc.) are set by token owner.
value_flows.order: 1. Owner sets listing details. 2. Listing stored in token extension.

value_flows.description: Acceptance of rental/sale offers. Deposits are transferred to contract. Ownership/approval may be transferred.
value_flows.order: 1. Buyer/trenter submits offer. 2. Contract validates and transfers deposit. 3. If auto_approve, token approval/ownership changes.

value_flows.description: Withdrawal of funds. Landlord/host withdraws earned rent or sale proceeds. Contract tracks withdrawn amounts.
value_flows.order: 1. Landlord/host calls withdraw. 2. Contract checks available balance. 3. Funds sent to owner. 4. withdrawn_amount updated.

value_flows.description: Cancellation with refund. Percentage based on deadline. Refund sent to tenant/buyer.
value_flows.order: 1. Cancellation triggered. 2. Refund amount calculated. 3. Refund sent. 4. Rental/sale state updated.
